requests.prompt: CORO SOLTO / Caça ao Javaporco / Cidade Invadida — architectural pilot 1 of 3. Create ONE reusable two-storey Brazilian small-town corner grocery building, an exportable textured GLB for a Three.js FPS. Use the attached project concept image ONLY for architectural material language: restrained realistic plaster wear, clay roof tiles, human-scale windows and doors. Keep a consistent game-art style for all three pilots. This must be a BUILDING, not a rendered street scene. Roughly 8m wide, 7m deep, ground floor 3m high, upper floor 3m high. Ground floor grocery open to the street with a broad unobstructed entrance, actual hollow interior, removable shelves/counter/food crates. Walkable interior staircase to the upper floor with actual open windows overlooking the street and a usable rear flat-roof terrace. Separate named wall, floor, stair, roof and prop meshes; roof removable for inspection, door/window apertures physically empty, no invisible caps. Correct wall thickness, finished inner wall faces, human-scale stair treads. Meter units, Y up, ground-level pivot, clean reusable PBR materials, no baked lighting. No people, animals, weapons, logos or text. Architectural detail should suit the existing town rather than photoreal film geometry. Prioritize coherent navigable building geometry and export GLB. Report what openings/interiors actually exist and any limitation; do not claim game collision or navigation is already implemented. Produce only this one building, do not generate additional assets or buy credits.

CORO SOLTO / Caça ao Javaporco / Distrito Rural — architectural pilot 2 of 3. Create ONE reusable Brazilian farm barn and feed store building, exportable textured GLB for a Three.js FPS. Match the attached CORO SOLTO concept in game-art realism, human scale, plaster/clay/wood material detail and restrained wear; adapt architecture to a farm, do not copy the street or vehicles. Roughly 10m wide, 12m deep, 6m ridge height. Broad open barn doors, actual hollow ground-floor interior with removable feed sacks and storage crates as food attractors, walkable stairs to a partial upper hayloft, open upper window overlooking the yard, simple side loading porch. Partial loft leaves an open central barn volume. Separate named roof, floor, stair, wall and prop meshes; roof removable to inspect inside, all door/window openings physically empty with no invisible caps. Finished inner faces, correct wall thickness and usable stair treads. Meter units, Y up, ground pivot, reusable PBR materials, no baked lighting. Same visual family as the Brazilian grocery and Portuguese village house, not cartoon or film geometry. No characters, animals, weapons, text or logos. Prioritize coherent traversable architecture and export GLB. Report actual interior/access limitations; do not claim game collision or navigation already works. Produce only this one building, no extra generations and no credit purchase.

CORO SOLTO / Caça ao Javaporco / Vila da Mata — architectural pilot 3 of 3. Create ONE reusable two-storey Portuguese village house for a wooded hillside, exportable textured GLB for a Three.js FPS. Preserve the same game-art realism, human scale, texture detail and restrained wear as the attached project street concept; vary architectural identity, not rendering style. Whitewashed plaster, restrained blue and ochre trim, terracotta tiled gable roof, small tasteful ceramic tile panel, stone door surround, small walled rear courtyard and exterior stone steps. Roughly 7m wide, 7m deep, two 3m-high storeys. Actual hollow traversable ground-floor interior, an open front doorway, walkable interior stairs to a finished upper floor, actual open windows facing the street and courtyard so a player can shelter upstairs and aim outside. Separate named walls/floors/stairs/roof and courtyard pieces; removable roof, physically empty door/window openings, proper wall thickness and finished inner faces. Metric units, Y up, ground pivot, clean reusable PBR materials and no baked lighting. This is one building kit, not a whole village or a flat facade. No people, animals, weapons, text, brands, flags or logos. Prioritize coherent traversable architecture and export GLB. Report actual openings and access limitations without claiming collision/navigation are implemented. Produce only this one building, no extra generations and no credit purchase.
